notes: College of Arts and Humanities' American Studies Four Year Academic Plan. The source PDF's term grid converts to garbled, column-interleaved text (Fall/Spring cells for four years run together), so exact per-slot Fall/Spring placement could not be reliably reconstructed; flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md. Term placement here follows the plan's clearly-legible signals (AMST101 in Year 1, AMST340/AMST450 in Year 4 Fall/Spring respectively per the plan and catalog footnote 3) and otherwise spreads the remaining major requirements across Years 1-4 in the same order the plan lists them. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.
'Select one AMST 1xx or 2xx level course' filled with AMST202, from the catalog's own named list.

Americanist Foundation (2 courses) filled with AASP100 and SOCY200, both real 1xx/2xx courses in departments the catalog footnote names as examples (AASP, SOCY); the department's own approved list is not published in either source (see reviewNotes on the Program).
Select four 3xx or 4xx-level AMST courses filled with AMST310, AMST312, AMST315, and AMST320, all from the Academic Catalog list of real AMST courses.

Focus Area (12 credits, one non-AMST department) filled with SOCY310, SOCY320, SOCY335, and SOCY410 -- real SOCY courses already used elsewhere in this codebase (socy-major-2026-27.ts and its sample plan, sds-major-socy.json) -- chosen only to satisfy the single-department/level/credit shape.
